verdict.rationale: AWS ships a well-documented official CLI (aws-docs-1 through aws-docs-5, aws-docs-42, aws-probe-5) that covers virtually all AWS services and supports scripting/automation, which is core to agentic/AI-native workflows; it also has official MCP servers (aws-docs-50, aws-probe-4) enabling agent tool use. missing for 10: no explicit AI-native design docs for the CLI itself (e.g., structured output for LLM agents, agent-specific CLI features) and no independent hands-on review confirming AI-native usability of the CLI.
